remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. "H 16" on backing inscription is Downtown Gallery inventory number. Completed in Virginia before August move to Texas, on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: backing inscription, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Evening

credit_line: Gift of The Burnett Foundation and The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Horizontal watercolor of a blue hill with a half moon in the evening sky.  Foreground is a lavender field dotted sparsely with blue strokes of color suggesting bushes or trees.  Gently rounded blue hill in the middle, with a lighter blue sky above, with an orange slice moon hanging just above the hill in the middle of the sky.
